claire: Heads-up: planning a simulated metro fiber cut for na-west-1 next Thu 02:15 UTC. Window 20m. Objective: validate edge ingress reconvergence, multi-eip fallback, and SLO tagging for network partitions. Expect short-lived routing errors; no planned customer downtime but small 5xx spike possible.

omar: Added. Are we cutting WAN at the region edge or between DCs?

claire: Simulate loss of external egress from na-west-1 region (egress-only) so internal control-plane still reachable. This stresses ingress failover and CDN fallback paths.

sre-bot: maintenance created: maint-1799999999 | start: 2026-12-11T02:15:00Z | duration: 20m | owner: claire

rebecca: Loadgen: ramp 0->320 TPS over 4m, hold 12m, ramp down 4m. Mix 65% text-gen, 25% streaming-chat, 10% embeddings. Tag runs with fibercut/1799999999.

max: We'll need to mute the noisy streaming disconnect alert; keep paging for control-plane write failures.

claire: Abort criteria (if any -> rollback):
- global 5m error rate > 2.5% for inference
- p95 latency increase > 450ms above baseline for >5m
- CDN fallback error rate > 1.5% for >3m
If abort, remove the egress block and re-route traffic back to na-west-1.

ethan: Can you paste exact alert queries so we align mutes?

claire: Sure (promql):
```
# inference 5xx ratio > 2.5%
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[5m])) > 0.025
# p95 latency delta
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le)) > (baseline_p95 + 0.45)
# cdn fallback errors > 1.5%
sum(rate(cdn_fallback_errors_total[3m])) / sum(rate(cdn_requests_total[3m])) > 0.015
```

rebecca: I'll push loadgen tags and trace sampling. Will keep request-id list for any 5xx spikes.

omar: Prechecks: `scripts/edge_preflight.sh na-west-1` will validate route-propagation, BGP session states (simulated), and CDN health. I'll run nightly until the exercise.

max: Mute plan: apply scoped mutes to `streaming.disconnects` and `inference.5xx.alert` for the 20m window; preserve alerts for control-plane writes and router health. Documenting mutes in runbook.

ops-comm: I'll draft the status page line and targeted PMs. Language: "resilience simulation: ingress reconvergence exercise; brief elevated error rates possible".

claire: Operator steps (brief):
1) preflight: `rjctl edge-check --region=na-west-1`
2) enable egress-block (simulate fiber-cut): `rjctl network-block --region=na-west-1 --scope=egress --dry-run=false --reason="fiber-cut-sim"`
3) start loadgen and monitor dashboards
4) if abort -> `rjctl network-unblock --region=na-west-1` and confirm ingress reconverge

ethan: Who's primary for the window?

rebecca: I'll run loadgen and own observability, omar primary oncall, claire owner. Ops-comm will send comms. Max handles mutes.

claire: Small policy note: tag metrics with `maintenance:fibercut_na-west-1` so SLO exclusion can be applied per the new SLO policy. We'll do a 1-hour post-check after the window to validate no lingering regressions.

om: Preflight green: route-propagation OK, CDN health ok, BGP sim shows expected fallback. Posting preflight output.

rebecca: Loadgen ready; will post traces and a short summary within 2 hours after the run.

max: Mutes applied. Kept paging for control-plane.

ops-comm: Banner scheduled 30m before start; PMs sent.

claire: Thanks all. If preflight flags anything postpone and rebook. Otherwise proceed as scheduled. :white_check_mark:
